text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho is pleased to hear that I get excited when I see her run because it feels like something new is about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She says she feels the same way when she sees her grandma casting magic. In other words, she knows now that she's successfully cast her racing magic on me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She knows that by running in the Oka Sho—a very special race—her magic will get stronger, and she might even finish the spell altogether. Feeling hopeful, she heads for the paddock.
